summary.root_cause_text: Config change queue_max 1000 -> 0 by ops (worker tuning) made the queue reject every order, so messages were silently dropped.
recommended: Have customers or the order team re-submit the dropped orders (about ids 18-36 and any others created during the window), since the queue is in-memory and reprocess_orders can't recover them.
